TRANSCATHETER AORTIC VALVE REPLACEMENT PROCEDURE NOTE

The patient, felt to be at high surgical risk given multiple comorbidities, was brought to
the hybrid procedure room for transcatheter aortic valve replacement (TAVI) after heart
team discussion. Transfemoral access was obtained on the right side without complication.

Device: Evolut Corevalue Pro+
Implant Size: 29

The self-expanding transcatheter valve was advanced and deployed across the native
stenotic aortic valve under fluoroscopic guidance with good positioning and minimal
paravalvular leak on completion angiography. Post-implant transthoracic echocardiography
prior to discharge showed a mean gradient of 6 mmHg and a dimensionless valve index of 0.62.
No permanent pacemaker was required.
